cells.en: I'm grateful for your kindness.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن للطفك.
cells.description: Adult thanking someone for kindness

cells.en: I'm grateful for this opportunity.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن لهذه الفرصة.
cells.description: Learner appreciating a new opportunity

cells.en: I'm grateful for my family's support.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن لدعم عائلتي.
cells.description: Adult appreciating family support

cells.en: I'm grateful for the time you gave me.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن للوقت الذي خصصته لي.
cells.description: Adult thanking someone for their time

cells.en: I'm grateful for the chance to try again.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن لفرصة المحاولة مجددًا.
cells.description: Learner thanking a tutor for another attempt

cells.en: I'm grateful for your honest feedback.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن لملاحظاتك الصادقة.
cells.description: Adult thanking a colleague after constructive feedback

cells.en: I'm grateful for a quiet place to study.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن لوجود مكان هادئ أدرس فيه.
cells.description: Learner enjoying a peaceful study corner

cells.en: I'm grateful for the help our neighbors offered.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن للمساعدة التي قدمها جيراننا.
cells.description: Adult thanking neighbors after help with a move

cells.en: I'm grateful for every small improvement.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن لكل تحسن صغير.
cells.description: Learner recognizing gradual progress in a notebook

cells.en: I'm grateful for the extra time to prepare.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن للوقت الإضافي للاستعداد.
cells.description: Presenter thanking an organizer for more preparation time

cells.en: I'm grateful for the books you donated.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن للكتب التي تبرعت بها.
cells.description: Library volunteer accepting donated books gratefully

cells.en: I'm grateful for the way you listened without judging.
cells.ar: أنا ممتن للطريقة التي أصغيت بها دون إصدار أحكام.
cells.description: Adult thanking a friend after a supportive conversation

title: أنا مهتم بـ
form: I'm interested in + noun or verb ending in ing

cells.en: I'm interested in learning new languages.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بتعلم لغات جديدة.
cells.description: Adult exploring language-learning materials

cells.en: I'm interested in space and science.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالفضاء والعلوم.
cells.description: Adult viewing science and space displays

cells.en: I'm interested in improving my writing.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بتحسين كتابتي.
cells.description: Learner reviewing writing practice options

cells.en: I'm interested in joining the art club.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالانضمام إلى نادي الفن.
cells.description: Adult asking about an art club

cells.en: I'm interested in local history.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالتاريخ المحلي.
cells.description: Adult examining local history displays at a museum

cells.en: I'm interested in learning how to repair bicycles.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بتعلم كيفية إصلاح الدراجات.
cells.description: Adult observing bicycle repairs in a workshop

cells.en: I'm interested in the reasons behind your decision.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالأسباب وراء قرارك.
cells.description: Adult listening carefully during a discussion of a decision

cells.en: I'm interested in taking a photography course.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالالتحاق بدورة في التصوير.
cells.description: Adult reviewing a photography course with a camera nearby

cells.en: I'm interested in stories from different cultures.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بقصص من ثقافات مختلفة.
cells.description: Reader browsing a diverse collection of storybooks

cells.en: I'm interested in finding a better way to organize my time.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بإيجاد طريقة أفضل لتنظيم وقتي.
cells.description: Adult comparing planning methods beside a calendar

cells.en: I'm interested in the project, but I need more details.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالمشروع، لكنني أحتاج إلى مزيد من التفاصيل.
cells.description: Adult reviewing an incomplete project proposal

cells.en: I'm interested in helping at the next community event.
cells.ar: أنا مهتم بالمساعدة في الفعالية المجتمعية المقبلة.
cells.description: Adult speaking with a volunteer event organizer

title: لا أرغب في
form: I don't feel like + verb ending in ing

cells.en: I don't feel like going out tonight.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في الخروج الليلة.
cells.description: Adult declining an evening invitation

cells.en: I don't feel like watching TV.
cells.ar: لا أشعر برغبة في مشاهدة التلفاز.
cells.description: Adult choosing an activity other than television

cells.en: I don't feel like eating yet.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في الأكل بعد.
cells.description: Adult not ready to eat yet

cells.en: I don't feel like talking right now.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في الحديث الآن.
cells.description: Adult requesting quiet time rather than conversation

cells.en: I don't feel like cooking after such a long day.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في الطبخ بعد هذا اليوم الطويل.
cells.description: Tired adult considering an easy supper in the kitchen

cells.en: I don't feel like driving in this rain.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في القيادة تحت هذا المطر.
cells.description: Adult looking at heavy rain beside a parked car

cells.en: I don't feel like shopping in a crowded market.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في التسوق في سوق مزدحم.
cells.description: Adult deciding against entering a busy market

cells.en: I don't feel like answering more questions yet.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في الإجابة عن مزيد من الأسئلة بعد.
cells.description: Adult requesting a quiet break after a long discussion

cells.en: I don't feel like staying indoors all afternoon.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في البقاء داخل المنزل طوال فترة بعد الظهر.
cells.description: Adult looking toward a sunny outdoor space

cells.en: I don't feel like repeating the whole story.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في تكرار القصة كاملة.
cells.description: Adult gently declining to repeat a long explanation

cells.en: I don't feel like working alone today.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في العمل بمفردي اليوم.
cells.description: Adult approaching colleagues to work together

cells.en: I don't feel like making a decision until I've rested.
cells.ar: لا أرغب في اتخاذ قرار حتى أستريح.
cells.description: Tired adult setting aside a notebook of choices

cells.en: I think this lesson is useful.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن هذا الدرس مفيد.
cells.description: Learner discussing a useful lesson

cells.en: I think the blue shirt looks better.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن القميص الأزرق يبدو أفضل.
cells.description: Shopper comparing a blue shirt with another shirt

cells.en: I think we should start early.
cells.ar: أعتقد أنه ينبغي أن نبدأ مبكرًا.
cells.description: Team member suggesting an early start

cells.en: I think this story has a good ending.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن لهذه القصة نهاية جيدة.
cells.description: Readers discussing a story’s ending

cells.en: I think the bus is running late.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن الحافلة متأخرة عن موعدها.
cells.description: Passenger checking the time at a bus stop

cells.en: I think you left your keys on the table.
cells.ar: أعتقد أنك تركت مفاتيحك على الطاولة.
cells.description: Adult pointing toward keys on a table

cells.en: I think we have enough chairs for everyone.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن لدينا كراسي تكفي الجميع.
cells.description: Host counting chairs before guests arrive

cells.en: I think asking for help was the right choice.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن طلب المساعدة كان الخيار الصحيح.
cells.description: Learner reflecting on a useful tutoring conversation

cells.en: I think this route is shorter, but I'm not certain.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن هذا الطريق أقصر، لكنني لست متأكدًا.
cells.description: Travellers comparing two possible routes on a map

cells.en: I think she meant the other entrance.
cells.ar: أعتقد أنها قصدت المدخل الآخر.
cells.description: Visitors reconsidering directions outside a building

cells.en: I think the room would look brighter with lighter curtains.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن الغرفة ستبدو أكثر إشراقًا بستائر أفتح لونًا.
cells.description: Adults comparing light curtain fabrics in a room

cells.en: I think we should listen before making a decision.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن علينا الاستماع قبل اتخاذ قرار.
cells.description: Team allowing a colleague to explain during a meeting

cells.en: In my opinion, reading every day helps.
cells.ar: في رأيي، القراءة يوميًا مفيدة.
cells.description: Adults discussing daily reading practice

cells.en: In my opinion, the park is a great place to relax.
cells.ar: في رأيي، الحديقة مكان رائع للاسترخاء.
cells.description: Friends discussing a relaxing park

cells.en: In my opinion, we need more practice.
cells.ar: في رأيي، نحتاج إلى مزيد من التدريب.
cells.description: Learners reflecting on a need for more practice

cells.en: In my opinion, teamwork is important.
cells.ar: في رأيي، العمل الجماعي مهم.
cells.description: Team discussing the value of cooperation

cells.en: In my opinion, the earlier train is a better choice.
cells.ar: في رأيي، القطار الأبكر خيار أفضل.
cells.description: Travellers discussing two departure times

cells.en: In my opinion, this explanation is clearer.
cells.ar: في رأيي، هذا الشرح أوضح.
cells.description: Learners comparing two explanations of a task

cells.en: In my opinion, we should ask the neighbors first.
cells.ar: في رأيي، ينبغي أن نسأل الجيران أولًا.
cells.description: Community members discussing a shared-space plan

cells.en: In my opinion, a short daily practice session is easier to maintain.
cells.ar: في رأيي، الالتزام بجلسة تدريب قصيرة يوميًا أسهل.
cells.description: Adult discussing a manageable practice schedule

cells.en: In my opinion, the room needs more natural light.
cells.ar: في رأيي، تحتاج الغرفة إلى مزيد من الضوء الطبيعي.
cells.description: Adult considering window arrangements in a dim room

cells.en: In my opinion, listening carefully is part of being helpful.
cells.ar: في رأيي، الإصغاء بعناية جزء من تقديم المساعدة.
cells.description: Friends having a thoughtful supportive conversation

cells.en: In my opinion, the final decision should wait until everyone has spoken.
cells.ar: في رأيي، ينبغي تأجيل القرار النهائي حتى يتحدث الجميع.
cells.description: Team meeting with several participants waiting to speak

cells.en: In my opinion, the cheaper option is not always the best value.
cells.ar: في رأيي، الخيار الأرخص لا يقدم دائمًا أفضل قيمة.
cells.description: Shopper comparing the quality and prices of two items

cells.en: I believe everyone can learn.
cells.ar: أؤمن بأن الجميع يستطيع التعلم.
cells.description: Teacher expressing confidence in learners

cells.en: I believe we can solve this problem.
cells.ar: أعتقد أننا نستطيع حل هذه المشكلة.
cells.description: Team member encouraging a possible solution

cells.en: I believe honesty is important.
cells.ar: أؤمن بأن الصدق مهم.
cells.description: Adults discussing the value of honesty

cells.en: I believe practice makes a difference.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن التدريب يحدث فرقًا.
cells.description: Learner explaining a belief in continued practice

cells.en: I believe you can explain your idea clearly.
cells.ar: أعتقد أنك تستطيع شرح فكرتك بوضوح.
cells.description: Tutor encouraging a learner before a presentation

cells.en: I believe the missing key is in this drawer.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن المفتاح المفقود في هذا الدرج.
cells.description: Adult checking a drawer while searching for a key

cells.en: I believe we should give everyone a chance to speak.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن علينا منح الجميع فرصة للكلام.
cells.description: Meeting facilitator inviting quieter participants to speak

cells.en: I believe small improvements are worth noticing.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن التحسينات الصغيرة تستحق الانتباه.
cells.description: Learner and tutor reviewing gradual progress

cells.en: I believe the guide said the museum closes at five.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن المرشد قال إن المتحف يغلق عند الخامسة.
cells.description: Visitors recalling a guide's information about closing time

cells.en: I believe trust grows when people keep their promises.
cells.ar: أؤمن بأن الثقة تنمو عندما يفي الناس بوعودهم.
cells.description: Friends discussing a promise that was kept

cells.en: I believe this approach will save us some time.
cells.ar: أعتقد أن هذا الأسلوب سيوفر علينا بعض الوقت.
cells.description: Team comparing two methods for organizing a task

cells.en: I believe we can disagree and still treat each other with respect.
cells.ar: أؤمن بأننا نستطيع الاختلاف مع استمرار احترام بعضنا.
cells.description: Adults having a calm respectful disagreement

title: أفضل
form: I prefer + noun or verb ending in ing + to + alternative

cells.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
cells.ar: أفضل الشاي على القهوة.
cells.description: Adult choosing tea instead of coffee

cells.en: I prefer walking to driving.
cells.ar: أفضل المشي على القيادة.
cells.description: Adult choosing to walk instead of drive

cells.en: I prefer studying in the morning to studying late at night.
cells.ar: أفضل الدراسة صباحًا على الدراسة في وقت متأخر ليلًا.
cells.description: Learner comparing morning and late-night study plans

cells.en: I prefer quiet places to crowded ones.
cells.ar: أفضل الأماكن الهادئة على المزدحمة.
cells.description: Adult selecting a quiet place away from a crowd

cells.en: I prefer fresh fruit to sweets.
cells.ar: أفضل الفاكهة الطازجة على الحلوى.
cells.description: Adult choosing fruit beside a plate of sweets

cells.en: I prefer reading a book to scrolling on my phone.
cells.ar: أفضل قراءة كتاب على تصفح هاتفي.
cells.description: Adult putting a phone aside to read a book

cells.en: I prefer taking the train to driving long distances.
cells.ar: أفضل ركوب القطار على القيادة لمسافات طويلة.
cells.description: Traveller comparing a train journey with a long drive

cells.en: I prefer a clear explanation to a quick answer.
cells.ar: أفضل شرحًا واضحًا على إجابة سريعة.
cells.description: Learner asking a tutor for a fuller explanation

cells.en: I prefer cooking at home to eating out every night.
cells.ar: أفضل الطبخ في المنزل على الأكل خارجه كل ليلة.
cells.description: Adult preparing a home meal beside takeaway menus

cells.en: I prefer sending a short message to making a late-night call.
cells.ar: أفضل إرسال رسالة قصيرة على إجراء اتصال في وقت متأخر من الليل.
cells.description: Adult composing a message instead of placing a late call

cells.en: I prefer working with a small team to working alone.
cells.ar: أفضل العمل مع فريق صغير على العمل بمفردي.
cells.description: Adult joining a small collaborative work table

cells.en: I prefer asking a question to pretending I understand.
cells.ar: أفضل طرح سؤال على التظاهر بأنني أفهم.
cells.description: Learner raising a hand to request clarification

title: أتفق مع
form: I agree with + person or opinion

cells.en: I agree with your suggestion.
cells.ar: أتفق مع اقتراحك.
cells.description: Colleague agreeing with a suggestion

cells.en: I agree with my teacher on this point.
cells.ar: أتفق مع معلمي في هذه النقطة.
cells.description: Learner agreeing with a teacher’s point

cells.en: I agree with you about the schedule.
cells.ar: أتفق معك بشأن الجدول.
cells.description: Adults agreeing about a schedule

cells.en: I agree with her decision.
cells.ar: أتفق مع قرارها.
cells.description: Adult supporting a friend’s decision

cells.en: I agree with your explanation of the problem.
cells.ar: أتفق مع شرحك للمشكلة.
cells.description: Colleagues reviewing an explanation on a desk

cells.en: I agree with the plan to leave earlier.
cells.ar: أتفق مع خطة المغادرة أبكر.
cells.description: Travellers agreeing on an earlier departure plan

cells.en: I agree with you that we need more time.
cells.ar: أتفق معك في أننا نحتاج إلى مزيد من الوقت.
cells.description: Team members discussing a realistic project schedule

cells.en: I agree with her view on protecting the garden.
cells.ar: أتفق مع رأيها بشأن حماية الحديقة.
cells.description: Neighbors discussing care of a shared garden

cells.en: I agree with most of the feedback, but not all of it.
cells.ar: أتفق مع معظم الملاحظات، لكن ليس معها جميعًا.
cells.description: Adult reviewing feedback with some items marked for discussion

cells.en: I agree with the decision to ask the whole team.
cells.ar: أتفق مع قرار سؤال الفريق كله.
cells.description: Colleague supporting consultation at a team meeting

cells.en: I agree with what you said about listening carefully.
cells.ar: أتفق مع ما قلته عن الإصغاء بعناية.
cells.description: Adults agreeing after a thoughtful conversation

cells.en: I agree with you on the goal, although I would choose a different method.
cells.ar: أتفق معك على الهدف، رغم أنني سأختار طريقة مختلفة.
cells.description: Colleagues comparing different methods for a shared goal

title: لا أتفق مع
form: I don't agree with + person or opinion

cells.en: I don't agree with that idea.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع تلك الفكرة.
cells.description: Adult respectfully questioning an idea

cells.en: I don't agree with the new schedule.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع الجدول الجديد.
cells.description: Colleagues debating a new schedule

cells.en: I don't agree with his conclusion.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع استنتاجه.
cells.description: Learners reviewing a disputed conclusion

cells.en: I don't agree with every part of the plan.
cells.ar: لست متفقًا مع جميع أجزاء الخطة.
cells.description: Adult reviewing a plan with some parts still under discussion

cells.en: I don't agree with the suggestion to cancel the class.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع اقتراح إلغاء الحصة.
cells.description: Learners discussing a proposal to cancel a class

cells.en: I don't agree with you about the best route.
cells.ar: لا أتفق معك بشأن أفضل طريق.
cells.description: Travellers respectfully comparing routes on a map

cells.en: I don't agree with the way the problem was described.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع الطريقة التي وُصفت بها المشكلة.
cells.description: Colleagues discussing two descriptions of a problem

cells.en: I don't agree with blaming one person for everything.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع إلقاء اللوم على شخص واحد في كل شيء.
cells.description: Team members calmly reviewing shared responsibility

cells.en: I don't agree with that conclusion because the evidence is incomplete.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع ذلك الاستنتاج لأن الأدلة غير مكتملة.
cells.description: Adult pointing out missing information in a report

cells.en: I don't agree with all her opinions, but I respect her.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع جميع آرائها، لكنني أحترمها.
cells.description: Adults maintaining a friendly tone while discussing different views

cells.en: I don't agree with the idea that asking questions is a weakness.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع فكرة أن طرح الأسئلة ضعف.
cells.description: Learner confidently asking for clarification in a class

cells.en: I don't agree with making a decision before everyone has spoken.
cells.ar: لا أتفق مع اتخاذ قرار قبل أن يتحدث الجميع.
cells.description: Meeting participant inviting others to share their views

cells.en: It seems like the shop is closed.
cells.ar: يبدو أن المتجر مغلق.
cells.description: Visitor noticing closed shop shutters

cells.en: It seems like everyone is ready.
cells.ar: يبدو أن الجميع مستعد.
cells.description: Organizer noticing everyone is prepared

cells.en: It seems like the weather is changing.
cells.ar: يبدو أن الطقس يتغير.
cells.description: Adult noticing changing clouds

cells.en: It seems like she enjoyed the party.
cells.ar: يبدو أنها استمتعت بالحفلة.
cells.description: Adult recalling someone’s enjoyment after a party

cells.en: It seems like the train is delayed.
cells.ar: يبدو أن القطار متأخر.
cells.description: Passengers noticing a long wait at a railway platform

cells.en: It seems like you have already solved the problem.
cells.ar: يبدو أنك حللت المشكلة بالفعل.
cells.description: Tutor noticing a completed solution in a learner's notebook

cells.en: It seems like the room needs more light.
cells.ar: يبدو أن الغرفة تحتاج إلى مزيد من الضوء.
cells.description: Adult assessing a dim study room

cells.en: It seems like we took the wrong turn.
cells.ar: يبدو أننا انعطفنا في الاتجاه الخطأ.
cells.description: Travellers reconsidering their route at a junction

cells.en: It seems like she is waiting for someone.
cells.ar: يبدو أنها تنتظر شخصًا.
cells.description: Adult observing a visitor checking the entrance repeatedly

cells.en: It seems like there is enough food for everyone.
cells.ar: يبدو أن هناك طعامًا يكفي الجميع.
cells.description: Host surveying food prepared for a gathering

cells.en: It seems like he understood the explanation this time.
cells.ar: يبدو أنه فهم الشرح هذه المرة.
cells.description: Tutor noticing a learner applying an explained method

cells.en: It seems like the plan is working, although it's too early to be certain.
cells.ar: يبدو أن الخطة تنجح، رغم أن الجزم بذلك ما زال مبكرًا.
cells.description: Team cautiously reviewing early progress on a project
